newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave official money market rates unchanged on Tuesday when it announces conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period.
A poll of 10 analysts from Portuguese banks and brokerages was unanimous in predicting that the Bank would leave its repurchase pact and drain rates unchanged at 6.50 and 6.20 percent, respectively.
But the analysts were also convinced that there was room for eventual cuts in Portuguese rates.
